editions.name: Polish Beatbox Championship 2021
editions.venue: Salony Muzyczne Riff, GAK Stacja Orunia

notes: MasnyB, Gnomek & Statystyk acted as replacements for [pl] JMBeats (PBB2025 Winner),  [pl] Spong (3rd Wildcard Winner) & [pl] KOMPOT (28th Wildcard Winner) dropped out due to personal reasons.
Shade and Gimbus were auto qualified for this year's Polish Champs, but they chose to make wildcards.
